sentences.en: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
sentences.zh: 结婚前睁大眼睛看清楚，婚后则要睁一只眼闭一只眼。

sentences.en: That way I'll have time to talk to you afterwards.
sentences.zh: 这样我才有时间在之后和你聊天。

sentences.en: Do you want to join us for a drink afterwards?
sentences.zh: 你想在之后加入我们喝一杯吗？
